call_id.notes: Unique identifier; usually dropped for modeling.

call_date.notes: Raw date string; useful only if engineered into day/month/week.

call_time.notes: Raw time string; useful only if engineered into hour-of-day.

agent_name.notes: Human-readable agent name; redundant with agent_id.

call_transcript.notes: Raw transcript; not used directly for tabular models.

call_successful.notes: Binary success flag; may cause leakage depending on target.

customer_service_count.notes: Number of service interactions in the last year.

customer_issue_history.notes: Count of past issues or complaints.

clean_transcript.notes: Preprocessed transcript; used to generate engineered features.

word_count.notes: Total number of words in the transcript.

avg_word_length.notes: Average word length across the transcript.

num_exclamation_marks.notes: Count of exclamation marks; proxy for emotional intensity.

emotion_scores.notes: Emotion intensity scores extracted from transcript.

agent_turns.notes: Number of times the agent speaks.

customer_turns.notes: Number of times the customer speaks.

billing_dispute_flag.notes: Whether the call involves a billing dispute.

outage_history_flag.notes: Whether the customer recently experienced an outage.

qa_score.notes: Provides an overall rating of the interaction between the customer and agent.

sentiment_shift.notes: Measure of the gradient shift of sentiment throughout the conversation.
